notes.title: v0.0.9
notes.content:
🔥 New Features



   128 Tickrate Servers  



  Servers now run at 128 tickrate, offering more responsive gameplay at the cost of higher network usage.



   New Weapon: SG553  

  

     Available to Terrorists.  

     Effective at long range and in 1v1 scenarios, but underperforms in 1vX situations.

  





   New Grenade: Decoy  

  

     Emits sounds mimicking your held weapon.  

     Useful for misleading enemies and creating tactical distractions.

  





   Unique Buy Menus in Bomb Mode  

  

     Counter-Terrorists and Terrorists now have distinct buy options, enhancing economic and gameplay differences between the teams.

  





   UI Audio Enhancements  

  

     Added satisfying new sound effects to the menu interface.

  



🛠 Fixes & Improvements



   Map Changes

  

     Rebalanced De_Metro.

     Adjusted De_Construction:  

    

       Fixed hitbox issues on the car.  

       Redesigned long and catwalk areas for better flow.

    

  





   Gameplay Tweaks

  

     HE Grenade now applies a strong slowing effect, turning it into more of a utility tool rather than pure damage.

     Default camera and aiming behavior now uses snapping for improved control.

  





   Weapon Balance

  

     M4A1 price reduced: 3100 → 2900  

     SG553 price set to 3000  

     AUG price set to 3300  

     Elephant Gun reworked: now functions like a Scout (SG) and costs 1700

  





   Fix damage sound being played to EVERYONE

notes.title: Friday Bits #03
notes.content:
Hey guys! Von Bonin here,

Today I’d like to show you the utility side of our game—the strategy, the finesse, which are the grenades. I’m running a little late, but still managed to get this update written in time for the weekend family gathering.

As for the weapons, I’m also planning on adding some more grenades in the future, and I’m open to suggestions as always—so feel free to reach out at any point!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/653251fade1bd24260b87fb5c5243bcc42fbc8a9.png

The current game has 4 types of grenades:
- Hand grenades, which explode on impact
- Flashbangs, for those delicious white screens
- Smoke grenades, which create a curtain you cannot see through
- Molotovs, for setting things on fire—including yourself

These 4 grenades are expected to become 6 in the future, with the addition of a sound decoy grenade as well as a flare grenade, which lets you see an area you normally would not have vision of.

All these grenades have strategic uses and situations. For example, I often like to use molotovs to set the bombsite on fire when the bomb is about to explode as the Red Team—or to block an opposing team’s rush into a bombsite.

Here are some pictures with the visual effect of each one so you are able to know what to expect in each case.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/6ac9a3c35f73fc6951516d5c5a71e4e0549fe39c.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/657f88bb29a711ad27154284369652fcdd4782dd.png

I recommend that you boot up the game and experiment during matches to see which grenades best suit your playstyle. Since you can carry up to 4 grenades at a time, there’s plenty of room to experiment and be strategic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/ea684fe8eaa8d9bba21fc405d4125bea8801f6c3.png

Ah, there’s also a trail that shows where your grenade will land (when you’re not moving or running, of course), which helps you use them more effectively.

And that’s it—fast, quick, and furious. Don't forget to feed the fire mage.
I wish you a great weekend, and until next week,
Von Bonin

notes.title: Friday Bits #02
notes.content:
Hey guys! Von Bonin here,

Today, I want to take a moment to showcase the weapons currently available in the game. Each weapon has been designed with a unique playstyle in mind—whether you're into precision, raw power, CQC, sniping, or, like my friend Sied Muhamed, PURE UNFILTERED CHAOS.

More weapons are on the way in future updates, and I’d love to hear your ideas. Got a weapon in mind? I might just add it (especially if it’s cursed).

Intermission
This curated review is proudly sponsored by the Fire Mage (please keep him happy by pretending his molotov is a real fire spell).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/18e5d9e9d8bb1c3bccde9993c9952543ddbf1937.png

The Fire Mage also insists I tell you that each weapon has some distinctive features, including:
- Bullet size
- Damage
- Spread
- Slow applied
- Speed while holding

These variations enable a lot of dynamic play. For example, you can hold a knife to run faster to a point of interest and then switch to your real weapon—or fire a slowing weapon first, before delivering the actual damage.

Rifles
Rifles offer some of the longest ranges and highest damage output, making them ideal for mid-to-long range combat. These weapons are designed for precision and power, rewarding players who can better control recoil instead of just spraying and praying.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/37c1e24d03967d53610cc619060196c1306ecb9c.png

The current lineup includes:
- AK-47, the old reliable. Loud, proud, and deadly.
- M4A1, the good guy AK-47
- AUG, best weapon. Will need a nerf at some point... eventually… maybe.

Each weapon brings its own strengths and weaknesses. However, if you’re not a rifle guy but still like full-auto, prefer a more aggressive approach, and don’t want to think too hard—we have SMGs!

SMGs
For players who hear an echo when they think. Most bullets. Most fun. Just hold W and click.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/921ae5ce54e05e81ee42a1e1b33e3de9bbf373b7.png

The current lineup includes:
- P90, RUSH B CYKA.
- NEGEV, initially a dev weapon used to test network syncing and performance by pushing the game to its limits. Now included for 64 players to pick up and see who has the better PC.

Shotguns
Shotguns are built for close-quarters combat. Massive damage. Massive vibes. Just run into a room and delete people.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/fea5c5c3164a7707608a99b33b6783cf86fa893a.png

The current lineup includes:
- NOVA, also known as “Why aren’t you dead?! I hit you twice!”
- SPAS12, If you hear it cock and you're not already shooting… it’s over.

I usually prefer to stalk players around corner turns with these bad boys. However, you’ll need to find your own playstyle with them.

Pistols
Pistols are versatile, precise, and great at mid-to-close range combat. They offer more range than shotguns while remaining lightweight and accurate. This means you can walk and shoot without worrying too much about recoil or spread. Depending on the pistol type, they can function as a backup weapon or a precise tool for skilled players.

Pistols in the game come in two categories:
- Trace-based, hits instantly. Low damage. Great for sniping some chip damage.
- Projectile-based, slower shots, but way more Oof.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/8f61c24fbfb9078e04ea4c8b6a1b2a8055052c5a.png

The current lineup includes:
- GLONK, GLONK
- KRUGER, balanced. Like all things should be.
- REVOLVER, high damage, big drama.
- USP, silenced and tactical. Smells like a covert op.
- HAND CANNON, … why did we implement this MONSTER?? Seriously.

Each pistol has its strengths, offering different playstyles and strategies. Let me know if you have any suggestions for the current setup or want to see other pistols included.

Snipers
Sniper rifles are designed for long-range precision, rewarding patience and accuracy.

Currently, the only sniper rifle available is:
- AWP, if you’ve played Counter-Strike, you already know. If you haven’t… you will.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/7665d6ffb1e786fc8883418d371e99122b826581.png

I’m working on adding a second sniper—maybe a semi-auto or something fast like the DRAGON-9. Stay tuned, and please do suggest more.

Melee
Melee is not just about stabbing—it’s about sending a message. Nothing makes an enemy panic more than seeing someone sprinting at them with a katana in hand. The fear causes them to run, and by running, they miss their shots—giving you the upper hand in close quarters… unless, of course, they’re holding a BAZOOKA or SPAS12.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/15c475de390f84df6cd3388f26549b9813ac542a.png

Right now, the only melee weapon available is the MACHETE, but we’re planning to add a SWORD, KNIFE, STONE, HANDS, and THROWING AXE in a future update. Each will bring its own playstyle, whether it’s speed, reach, or raw power. Got an idea? Pitch it. The weirder, the better.

Special Weapons
Special weapons add a level of chaos that changes the pace of a fight. Usually, they were designed just to test the game, but since they’re super fun, we decided to keep them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/db9e87bc187692b5becdd7c6dc0d0ac163da20f7.png

We’ve got the RPG-7, the ELEPHANT GUN, GRENADE LAUNCHERS, and a few others. These weapons are as fun as they are destructive, leading to some ridiculous moments in combat.

There’s more to discover—but you’ll have to play to find out.

Take care,
Von Bonin

notes.title: Friday Bits #01
notes.content:
Hey guys! Von Bonin here,

My friend and I were tired of working a 9-5 just to come home and clock into our second job—grinding Counter-Strike for another 9-5 just to stay competitive. We wanted a way to capture that awesome Counter-Strike experience but in a more relaxed, casual setting. That’s when we had an incredible idea—to combine the American Dream with our laid-back mindset and create a game where every player has a gun, plants bombs, and shoots their friends. And so, this is what we came up with:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45473614/7d1af6dc4e4664aefaa978f6ee72763c77a08f53.png

What started as a side project quickly evolved into a full-scale multiplayer game on Steam, and we’ve been working hard to bring it to life. Right now, we’re preparing a detailed roadmap for you, but here’s a sneak peek at what you can expect when the game is ready:
- Casual Deathmatch Mode 
- Co-op Horde/Extraction Mode
- Classic Bomb-Planting Mode
- Sandbox mode to test new weapons and tactics
- Public HUBs & Social Spaces to build new relationships
- Base Building & Progression 
- Steam Item Collection & Trading 
- Tons and tons of fun

We’ll be posting continuous updates to share our progress and showcase new features as we build them. Stay tuned for more exciting news! Follow us on our socials to stay updated!

Looking forward to sharing this journey with you all. See you in the game!

Take care,
Von Bonin
